Basalt

24.3k v1.4.2 · MIT

◆ OPEN SOURCE · COLUMNAR OLAP · BUILT FOR DATA ENGINEERS

Data, set in stone.

Basalt is an open-source analytical database that thinks in columns. One static binary, Postgres wire-compatible, append-only to the core — and fast enough to make your warehouse nervous.

01 · SEE IT RUN

A real query, really executed.

This page embeds a 200,000-row columnar store and a tiny vectorized engine. The timings below are measured with a profiler clock — not typed by the marketing team.

Every run scans live typed arrays: filter, hash aggregate, sort. Refresh the page and the dataset regenerates.

02 · FITS THE PIPELINE

Drops into the stack you already run.

No sidecar, no coordinator, no new SDK. Basalt speaks the one protocol your tooling already speaks.
